messages:
jordan-collections: Heads up — put Nimbus Labs account on hold. INV-2026-0092 ($38,450) overdue beyond 30 days. Customer says procurement requires PO before any payment; their card attempts failed with 'billing_vat_mismatch'.

payments-bot: Automated dunning notice sent to customer at 2026-09-23T14:12:03Z. Attempt #4.

maria-billing: Can we hold off suspension for 48h? AM says PO coming and AP needs revised invoice line for VAT.

natalie-am: Confirmed — customer just sent PO-7782 via email but they didn't include their VAT ID on the PO. AP asked for invoice that shows 'reverse charge' for EU VAT. They asked if we can lift service while they process.

kevin-cs: AP team comment: "we can't pay until PO + invoice match exactly". They also said card declined twice (gateway gave 'insufficient_funds' then 'billing_vat_mismatch').

maria-billing: I can reissue invoice with 'Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted by customer' line and zero VAT, but I need the VAT ID for the billing record to generate correctly.

natalie-am: They just DM'd me VAT ID GB123456789. Forwarding invoice template now.

maria-billing: Reissued invoice INV-2026-0092-R1 with reverse charge note. Invoice link: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0092-R1

payments-bot: Gateway log excerpt:
```
TXN 0x9ab3... RETRY 2026-09-23 14:05:22 - DECLINE insufficient_funds
TXN 0x9ab3... RETRY 2026-09-23 14:09:10 - DECLINE billing_vat_mismatch
```

jordan-collections: Policy check: standard dunning allowed suspension after 30 days. Exception: collections lead can grant one 48h reinstatement to accomodate procurement workflows. Requesting approval from finance mgmt.

maria-billing: Approving one-time 48h lift if AM confirms follow-up and we add payment hold note + manual review if not paid.

natalie-am: I approve and will chase AP for same-day wire. If they send remittance, we'll apply immediately and close dunning.

kevin-cs: Customer AP replied: "PO and remittance will go out today via wire. Expect beneficiary ref: PO-7782." Will post when done.

jordan-collections: Reinstated for 48h. Added internal tag `collections:reinstated-48h` and follow-up task assigned to maria-billing for 24h check.

maria-billing: Noted. I'll monitor and apply payment if received. If we don't see funds by 48h, we'll re-suspend and escalate to legal.

kevin-cs: Customer confirmed wire initiated. They asked if we can mark account active so integrations don't fail during testing. They will send remittance PDF shortly.

jordan-collections: OK. Keep thread updated. Closing for now but will reopen on payment or if AP stalls. :white_check_mark:
